Marta L.: FYI customs in FRA flagged 8 H100s from AWB 5917-DE-422 for a thermal inspection. Linked RMA: RMA-90733. These were destined for eu-edge-3 provisioning. Need quick triage.
HyperLane (vendor): Apologies, Marta. Customs requested thermal chamber calibration cert + trace logs. We can (A) push docs to customs for priority review (ETA ~24-48h, ~40% chance) or (B) send 8 replacement units from our NL buffer by air (ETA ~36-48h to depot) for +\u20ac16,500 expedited fee.
Devon R.: If replacements arrive in 36h to depot and we can pre-stage, that's acceptable but we need replacement serials now. Also what are FW versions?
HyperLane (vendor): Replacements are serials HL-S100*-REP, firmware 2.1.3, BIOS 1.8. Full manifest sent to ops email.
Claire P.: Cost / business question: which customers are affected? Marta, any SLA exposure?
Marta L.: Affected onboarding: GeoSense (enterprise trial), BrightCart (pilot), and MedAlign (compliance). GeoSense is most sensitive. Potential SLA credits if onboarding misses 48h window. Approx immediate exposure ~\u20ac18k plus churn risk.
Devon R.: Ops mitigation options: (1) borrow 4 H100s from dedicated-eu-standby (2) enable aggressive KV-cache reuse and quantized instance profiles for onboarding-eu route (3) request shortened batch windows for latency-critical teams. Borrowing reduces risk but disrupts other tenants.
Marta L.: How fast can we get dedicated pool borrow approved?
Claire P.: Finance ok to cover up to \u20ac20k emergency spend for critical onboarding. Approve only if vendor ETA <72h. Chargeback cost center INFRA-EMERG-01, bill to Sales-GeoSense.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0418-FRA-THERMAL. Auto-drain nodes: eu-edge-3a*; link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0418-FRA-THERMAL
Devon R.: If we choose air-replace, ops needs the serials in #images to pre-load AMIs and the network ACLs updated. Runbook snippet to switch routing:
```
# fallback to dedicated standby pool
redwood route patch --name onboarding-eu --pool dedicated-eu-standby --weight 80
# reduce immediate load by enabling quantized profile
redwood profile set --name onboarding-eu --profile quantized-low-memory
```
HyperLane (vendor): We can proceed with air-replace. Manifest & airwaybill HL-5917-REPL sent. We'll also start a customs appeal for the originals and attempt refund for expedited fee if originals clear. RMA handle updated: RMA-90733-EXP.
Marta L.: Claire, approve emergency procurement?
Claire P.: Approved up to \u20ac20k for GeoSense only. Document cost center and request Sales SIG to accept chargeback.
Devon R.: Confirmed. Marta, once serials are posted I'll kick off pre-provisioning and smoke test. Small note: FW 2.1.3 requires kernel patch KP-1148 on our side; we have that staged.
HyperLane (vendor): Patch note acknowledged. Replacements are compatible. Sending serial list now.
Marta L.: Received serials. Kicking off kernel_check and image bake. ETA readiness ~14h after depot arrival due to staging.
Claire P.: Logging decision and cost. Sales looped in. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: INC-2026-0418-FRA-THERMAL updated: status -> actioned (air-replace approved). Expected depot arrival 48h.
